exampleText: My mom starts chemo next week and I'm scared. Please pray for her and for me.

devotional.opening: Carrying someone you love through illness is holy, exhausting love. Let's bring her to God together.

saints.name: St. Peregrine Laziosi
saints.story: A Servite friar who developed a painful cancerous wound in his leg. Facing amputation, he prayed through the night and, according to tradition, was healed. He is invoked by people facing cancer and serious illness.
saints.why: St. Peregrine Laziosi, patron of those with cancer, is a patron of people with cancer and serious illness. A Servite friar who developed a painful cancerous wound in his leg.

saints.name: St. Raphael the Archangel
saints.region: Named in the Book of Tobit
saints.story: His name means "God heals." In the Book of Tobit he travels in disguise with young Tobias, protects him on the road, helps him find his wife Sarah, and brings healing to Tobias's blind father.
saints.why: St. Raphael the Archangel, angel of healing and safe journeys, is a patron of healing and travelers. His name means "God heals." In the Book of Tobit he travels in disguise with young Tobias, protects him on the road, helps him find his wife Sarah, and brings healing to Tobias's blind father..

saints.name: St. Pio of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio)
saints.story: A Capuchin friar who spent long hours hearing confessions, founded a major hospital and carried physical and spiritual suffering for decades. His well-known counsel: "Pray, hope, and don't worry."
saints.why: St. Pio of Pietrelcina, who told us to pray, hope, and not worry, is a patron of civil defense volunteers and adolescents. A Capuchin friar who spent long hours hearing confessions, founded a major hospital and carried physical and spiritual suffering for decades.

prayer.title: A prayer for my mom's healing
prayer.body:
Lord Jesus, You healed everyone who was brought to You. I bring You my mom. Lay Your healing hands on her. Guide her doctors and nurses, give her strength for every treatment, ease her pain, and let her feel how deeply they are loved.

St. Peregrine Laziosi, patron of those with cancer, pray for my mom and for me.

Thank You for loving her even more than I do.

scripture.text: Heal me, O Lord, and I will be healed. Save me, and I will be saved; for you are my praise.
scripture.connection: Write it somewhere you'll see it today.

scripture.text: Don't be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
scripture.connection: Write it somewhere you'll see it today.

devotions.title: Anointing of the Sick
devotions.description: A sacrament of strength and healing for anyone facing serious illness, surgery or the frailty of age. Call your parish to ask a priest.
devotions.suggestion: Consider it this week, when you have a quiet moment.

devotions.title: The Divine Mercy Chaplet
devotions.description: Prayed on ordinary rosary beads, traditionally at 3 p.m., the hour of mercy. On each bead: "For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world." It takes about seven minutes.
devotions.suggestion: Consider it this week, when you have a quiet moment.

devotions.title: Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel
devotions.text: St. Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, cast into hell Satan and all the evil spirits who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.
devotions.suggestion: Pray it slowly, perhaps once in the morning and once at night.

devotional.reflection: Healing comes in many forms: in the body, in the heart, in the love that gathers around us. Watch for all of them today.

art_brief.title: Held in the Night Garden
art_brief.concept: A symbolic meditation on my body and its healing.
art_brief.central_symbol: a figure resting inside a healing arch of turquoise glass
motifs: a figure sheltered beneath great wings of patterned paper
a geode of light at the heart
